title: Serial killer pore investigation: protocol for analyzing fatigue failure pores in Ti6Al4V
author: Muofhe Tshibalanganda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yebftan
materials: Save the defect analysis as csv file.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Scanning
steps.instruction: Secure the sample for microCT scanning to ensure stability and orientation.

substeps.instruction: Wrap the sample inside bubble wrap for support.
Ensure the marked threaded grip is facing up to identify the orientation during analysis.
Load the sample onto a foam base (e.g., florist oasis).

steps.title: Perform MicroCT Scanning
steps.instruction: Scan the sample using a Phoenix V|Tome|X L240 (General Electric Sensing and Inspection Technologies Phoenix X-ray, Wunstorff, Germany) microCT system.

steps.title: Reconstruct 3D Data
steps.instruction: Reconstruct the 3D data using General Electric Datos 2.2.

substeps.instruction: Apply a beam hardening correction value of 8 to reduce beam hardening artefacts.

steps.title: Initial 3D Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform initial analysis and registration using Volume Graphics VGSTUDIO MAX 3.2.

substeps.instruction: Register the sample using simple registration to turn the sample upright in the software windows.

steps.title: Denoise Initial Volume
steps.instruction: Apply the Adaptive Gauss filter to denoise the data and create a new volume.

substeps.instruction: Set smoothing factor to 0.8.
Set edge threshold to 0.1.
Set iteration to 1.

steps.title: Perform Porosity Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute porosity analysis using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: Set Probability to 0.
Set minimum voxel to 8.
Set maximum voxel to 400.
Use Auto threshold deviation.
Select the edge distance calculation.

steps.title: Extract Region of Interest (ROI)
steps.instruction: Isolate the sample volume and remove artifacts.

substeps.instruction: Use the ellipse Region of Interest to crop the sample, excluding the area with the cone beam artefact.
Extract the region of interest to create a new volume.

steps.title: Define Material Surface
steps.instruction: Define the material using surface determination.

substeps.instruction: Use both automatic and advanced modes for surface determination.

steps.title: Analyze Failure Area
steps.instruction: Perform high-resolution analysis on the specific area of failure.

substeps.instruction: Crop out 4 mm in the area of failure.
Denoise using the non local mean filter with a smoothing factor of 2.
Define the material again using surface determination in automatic and advanced modes.

steps.title: Identify Crack Initiating Pores
steps.instruction: Identify potential crack initiating pores closest to the surface by sorting by minimum edge distance.

steps.title: Save and Export Data
steps.instruction: Save the analyzed data for further review.

substeps.instruction: Save the filtered data set as an image stack (tiff) for manual viewing.
Save the analyzed volume for opening in free myVGL software.
